title: Man Threatens & Spits On Officer Then Sues Police for $15 Million
description:
On January 22, 2021, an officer conducted a traffic stop after noticing a vehicle didn’t have a license plate and a passenger wasn’t wearing a seatbelt in Waukesha, WI. During the investigation, they took the driver into custody for an active felony warrant. While in custody, the man threatened and spit on a police officer. 

Due to his uncooperative behavior, he was placed in a restraint chair. After the traffic stop encounter, the man filed a $15 million lawsuit against the officer and the Waukesha Police department for excessive use of force.
